title: Provide keyboard paths for every primary action
description: Audit and harden primary authoring, validation, preparation, calibration-draft, and recovery actions so each has a complete keyboard path, including non-drag alternatives for ordering, assignment, and overlay positioning.
acceptanceCriteria: Every named primary action is reachable and operable with keyboard alone
Content ordering, position assignment, and overlay positioning have semantic non-pointer controls
Hover and drag interactions, where retained, are optional enhancements rather than required paths
Keyboard operations provide the same validation, confirmation, refusal, and undo protections as pointer operations

steps.details: Create a focused matrix of actions across project, geometry, content, safe-area, setup, sheet, preparation, calibration, and recovery workflows.
Exercise the matrix using Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, arrows, and documented shortcuts; record unreachable or drag-only actions.
Implement buttons, selects, numeric inputs, move controls, and position forms that invoke the same domain commands as pointer interactions.
Add focused component/browser checks for each repaired gap, including confirmation, validation, refusal, and undo behavior.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; repair one bounded action matrix slice and its focused tests.
Spatial previews may remain visual, but their required operations and meaning need semantic alternatives.
